summary: Frontend-only regression test of the visual redesign (icon-rail sidebar, dark theme, watermark headings). Everything works: admin login reaches Painel (ceo-greeting) with the new watermark 'OBELISCO' behind the title. Icon-rail nav testids nav-painel, nav-conselhos, nav-saude, nav-valor, nav-futuro, nav-ceo, nav-financas, nav-relatorios, nav-empresa (routes to /definicoes), nav-admin all click and navigate without runtime error overlays; active item shows the blue highlight. Rail bottom actions restart-tour-btn (opens tour, dismissible via tour-skip-btn), nav-subscricao, logout-btn all work; company-selector opens a dropdown showing add-company-trigger. Pages Painel(/), Futuro, /ceo, /relatorios, /planos, /admin render cleanly. Pricing shows plan-founder, checkout-founder, plan-professional, plan-enterprise. Admin shows admin-page. Free-tier gating verified with a fresh user registered via /api/auth/register: all six gated rail items (nav-saude/valor/ceo/relatorios/conselhos/futuro) route the free user to /planos; direct /saude and /valor show upgrade-wall; Painel shows premium-locked-block (loads after ~4s). Mobile (390x844): mobile-menu-btn opens the Sheet drawer; drawer contains nav-painel-m, nav-saude-m, nav-conselhos-m, nav-ceo-m, nav-futuro-m, nav-valor-m, nav-relatorios-m, nav-financas-m and navigation works. No 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay observed on any page. No page-error events fired.

issues: ceo-greeting shows before the priority/health blocks resolve (~3-4s spinner in main content area for the first load). Not a redesign regression; premium-locked-block does appear after the fetch completes.

critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout redesign preserves all pre-existing data-testids (desktop) and adds -m variants for the mobile drawer as documented. No regressions detected.
Note that nav-empresa routes to /definicoes (not /empresa). Confirm this matches the intended IA (spec labels it 'Empresa').
